li.p: Do not use high beam when there are other vehicles. Using high beam could obstruct the other driver’s vision.
For your safety, change the Settings after parking the vehicle at a safe location.

note.p: To prevent the battery from being discharged, do not leave the headlight and interior light on for a prolonged time while the vehicle is not running.

li.p: The vehicle must be in the POWER ON or DRIVE READY position to turn on the headlights.
Depending on the instrument cluster specifications or theme, images or colors may be displayed differently.
